steps.content: The giant fish struggles, eventually landing on the last piece of land on Elysiland.
After the dazzling colors fade, L.L. is left alone, sitting with her back to you.
This was the most spectacular battle created by L.L. She used herself as the power source to summon the most imposing boss, full of challenges and sparkling special effects.
You gave it your all, used your wits, and won beautifully. The moment the monster is defeated, L.L. sets off a massive amount of fireworks just for you, covering the sky.
Watching you walk out of the light, approaching the defeated as the victor, L.L. smiles happily.
Isn't this victory glorious enough? It should have satisfied his hero complex. He must be very happy, right?
steps.female_content: Isn't this victory glorious enough? It should have satisfied her hero complex. She must be very happy, right?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Yes, I just love seeing people being satisfied.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I can't see the big world outside, but you guys can. You always bring the most interesting experiences from the outside to me, and it makes me happy too.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Come, let me see your face... I've enjoyed the joy of so many people, but I've never empathized with a real hero.
But when that person approaches and looks straight at her, she's stunned.
His face shows no pleasure. The anger, seriousness, and even that unwavering determination he had is gone.
steps.female_content: Her face shows no pleasure, the anger, seriousness, and even that unwavering determination she had is gone.

steps.content: What remains is an expression L.L. has never seen before. A sad, restrained expression, he looks straight at L.L. as if he has many things to say.
steps.female_content: What remains is an expression L.L. has never seen before. A sad, restrained expression, she looks straight at L.L. as if she has many things to say.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...Why this face?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Wasn't it satisfying enough? Wasn't your victory glorious enough?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Tell me everything. I will try my best to make you happy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This battle was already very satisfying, thank you. I am very satisfied.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So now I want to make you happy as well.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Make me happy?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Elysiland is done for. Mania has corrupted it, and it's now hurting you. You need to say goodbye to it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There are other joyful places in this world. If you trust me, I can take you to see them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Aren't you curious why the guests left Elysiland? You can see such a place with your own eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Beyond Elysiland and the dark web, there is a bigger world. You can go there yourself. You can find joy yourself without borrowing others' dreams, and then share it with others.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just like you find ways to make us happy, I will find a way to make you happy, okay?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No matter what, you are not alone anymore.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I promise you.
As you speak, you reach out to L.L.
But the girl looks at you blankly until the sunset, which is no longer controlled by the island owner, illuminates both of you.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hehe... there won't be a better place than here, I know it...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: It's...
L.L. remains kneeling, the sunlight falls in your palm, and she just stares blankly.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...so warm...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: The place you mentioned... does it have sunlight like this?
Her expression softens, and she slowly raises her hand.
Her voice abruptly stops, and the distance between you is suddenly widened! A force is pulling you up, dragging you out of the underwater world.
The island starts to sink, but the blue-haired girl has disappeared.
Under the sunlight, countless bubbles reflect dazzling colorful lights, pushing you out of the deep sea.

steps.speaker: News Report
steps.content: Recently, there have been cases of unexplained comas. After investigation, it has been confirmed that they are caused by shock symptoms from internet stimulations...

steps.speaker: News Report
steps.content: Currently, all patients have regained consciousness, and no obvious aftereffects have been found. Their mental states are being closely monitored by the hospital...
In the hospital, patients in the psychiatric ward groan one after another, talking about daily complaint and fantasies.
"I want lots and lots of money," "I want beauties," "I want handsome guys!" "I want to skip work," "I want to eat without getting fat!"
But after shouting, no one speaks again. They look at the white clouds and blue sky outside the window, pinching themselves a bit fearfully to prove they are still in reality world.

steps.speaker: Strange Man
steps.content: It's time to wake up, Lore-Ley.
In the run-down bathroom, two computer screens alternate between pink and blue light, reflecting on the clear water in the bathtub.
A girl lies on her back in the bathtub, slowly opening her eyes.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: …It's you?

steps.speaker: Strange Man
steps.content: Yes, it's me.

steps.speaker: Strange Man
steps.content: It was very dangerous just now. They sent me to get you. Luckily, I found you in time.

steps.speaker: Strange Man
steps.content: You're pushing yourself too hard. The dark web's power is strong and can easily harm you. You need to be discreet with it.

steps.speaker: Strange Man
steps.content: Look, you've been unconscious for so long, you were almost caught by that man and lost your freedom forever. Your value is much more than that. Be careful next time.
steps.female_content: Look, you've been unconscious for so long, you were almost caught by that woman and lost your freedom forever. Your value is much more than that. Be careful next time.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Next time...

steps.speaker: Strange Man
steps.content: Yes, your desired paradise isn't complete yet, right? Don't let such boring people stop you.

steps.speaker: Strange Man
steps.content: Go and build the next Elysiland.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Really, he almost got me... hehe...
steps.female_content: Really, she almost got me... hehe...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: That's... quite unfortunate...
A flash of white light wakes you up. You almost spring up from the bed. Gasping for air, like someone who has been holding their breath underwater for a long time and finally breathes.
You rush to the terminal, open your email, and find the message from the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center.
[Elysiland cracked, tracked "Island Owner" IP to 146.2.1.■■■, excluding proxy factors, possible geographic location—]
Moore sent a link, which is the offline address of the Elysiland owner's IP.
You click on the link, it's an very old building with almost no residents in Eastside.
You rush out.
The sun has fully risen, making people sweat lightly, which immediately evaporates.
You lead a team, following the coordinates Moore gave you, acting as fast as possible.
The stairwell is cold and humid, with inconspicuous water stains that haven't been evaporated by the sun.
You sense something is wrong and immediately run upstairs.
The run-down room you saw in L.L.'s consciousness appears before you, with no extra furniture, just an old bathtub by the window.
The two computers set on the bathtub are still on, displaying the forum page you are very familiar with.
Welcome to Elysiland!
